subject: Career
title: Dress Code Psychology
description: Learn Dress Code Psychology in one minute.

hook.text: Overdressing for a startup makes you look clueless. Underdressing for a bank says you don't care.

buildup.text: Enclothed cognition research shows clothes change how others perceive you and how you feel.

discovery.text: The rule: dress one level above the company's daily norm. It signals respect without trying too hard.

twist.text: In remote interviews, what you wear still matters. Your brain performs differently in pajamas.

climax.text: The goal isn't fashion — it's removing distraction so your answers become the focus.

punchline.text: Dress so nobody thinks about what you wore.

quiz.question: What does enclothed cognition research show?

details.summary: Clothing influences both how others perceive you and how you perceive yourself, a phenomenon researchers call enclothed cognition. Dressing one level above the company's standard signals ambition while still fitting the culture.
details.whyItMatters: Appropriate dress removes a potential distraction and signals that you understand and respect the company culture, letting your qualifications take center stage.
takeaways: Research the company dress code before choosing interview attire
Dress one level more formal than the daily company standard
Enclothed cognition means your clothing affects your own performance

faq.question: Does interview attire still matter in the era of casual dress codes?
faq.answer: Yes. Even in casual workplaces, showing up slightly more polished for an interview signals respect and seriousness. The key is matching approximately one level above daily norms rather than dramatically overdressing, which can create an awkward disconnect.

faq.question: What should you wear to a video interview versus an in-person one?
faq.answer: For video, focus on the top half with a solid-colored professional top and minimal distracting jewelry. Avoid busy patterns that pixelate on camera. Still dress professionally below the waist in case you need to stand unexpectedly.
